items.expect: Exit 0, including PASS Stacker for the registered Stacker cabinet, with successful launch, mute and return to menu.
items.source: Confirmed goal; proposed invocation from scripts/check_all.py:7–12; existing behavior assertions in scripts/check_arcade.py:38–65. Prerequisite: Stacker must be registered as a noncredentialed cabinet; this check alone cannot detect omitted registration. items.how_to_judge: Play Stacker alongside existing cabinets. Inspect shared paper/ink/jade presentation, readable controls and states, consistent overlays and short mechanical feedback. Confirm the game feels part of tink-arcade rather than a neon cabinet imitation.
items.source: Confirmed goal; README.md:23–26 and DESIGN.md:134–169; earlier presentation findings remain in the ledger.

items.expect: Successful Stacker actions produce appropriate audible mechanical cues across repeated plays; mute and --no-sound suppress playback as specified; unavailable audio does not prevent play; resources are released on exit. Repeated playback advances and sample levels are nonzero; listening confirms quality on the intended output device.

items.expect: Moving rows lock according to fair skill-based timing; only overlapping blocks survive, overhang is lost, zero overlap ends the run, and successful rows progress automatically toward the top without a take-the-minor-win choice. Deterministic regression assertions cover these behaviors, and play inspection confirms recognizable Stacker feel.
items.missing: Stacker rules implementation, verified rules calibration and behavior-specific tests are absent. Establish an exact invocation once those tests exist; overlap-retention assertions should fail under a targeted overhang-rule reversion, and progression assertions should fail if automatic advancement toward the top is removed.
items.source: Confirmed goal; settled stacker-fidelity answer “skill” and prize-progression answer “aim for top.” Earlier repository search found no Stacker implementation or tests.
